description: This Java source file defines the 'Log' helper class for Android, wrapping Android's native logging facilities to provide a customizable logging interface, including log level constants, setting and getting log nodes, and various methods for logging messages at different levels.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for managing and forwarding log messages through LogNodes, mimicking the Android Log utility with added customization.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode data will be sent to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Instructs the LogNode to print the log data provided; can include Throwable for exceptions.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message or exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion that something unexpected happened, optionally with an exception.
